title: The wordpress stack skill meets the stack-skill bar
body:
Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-skills-1115l.md slice 3 (wordpress)
Why: an adopted wordpress repository gets no procedure for writing good wordpress code; only a TypeScript skill exists and it is KRN-hand-kept.
Outcome: src/adopt/skills/wordpress/SKILL.md meets the stack-skill bar enforced by test/adopt/stack-skills.test.ts: at most 40 lines, description with use and skip triggers, a compatibility field, every backticked command binary on the stack allowlist, no "krn" token; sources: the typescript skill, boilerplate-2026 skills (frontend/wordpress: cube-css, acf-component, wp-runtime), src/brain/first-test.ts recipes, standards/records.json.
Files: src/adopt/skills/wordpress/, test/adopt/stack-skills.test.ts
Proof: stack-skills test passes for wordpress; adopt on the wordpress outside scratch copy installs it.
Predicted: outside hidden >= 1 in >= 1 rows
